application_contract.scalar_guard: Apply only when reviewed candidate is approved and current parent cell exactly equals source_value; otherwise preserve parent. Equal proposed/parent values are no-ops.
application_contract.joint_guard: All source values must exactly match the current parent tuple and the whole bundle must be approved. Apply every update atomically, or preserve the full parent tuple. Never flatten a bundle into scalar candidates.
application_contract.post_application: Root performs parent-relative whole-tuple sandbox verification separately; author does not apply or evaluate.

files_per_dataset.pass4.json: Framework schema {dataset,model,reasoning_effort,dirty_sha256,sample_row_ids,rules,dependencies,value_repairs,valid_values,notes}. New checkers; no automatic factual repair map. Rule IDs reference contract IDs.
files_per_dataset.column_contracts.json: Every column: header, semantic type, declared/inferred unit, representation assumptions, competing hypotheses, evidence counts/coverage, canonical rendering, contract status, limitations and checker IDs.

cells.original_valid_score: uncalibrated format-conformance score, not factual validity probability

files_per_dataset.runtime_validation.json: Every generated checker and full-dirty-row runtime acceptance/error count, separately from semantic support.
files_per_dataset.sampling_provenance.json: Row IDs, hashes, deterministic format/context strata, and honest grouped model-review limits.

authorship: One model agent reviews groups and authors converter templates. Per-cell execution is deterministic code, not a per-cell LLM/API response.
immutability: Author outputs freeze in manifest.json before independent review/application or any feedback. Review/application results go outside the author directory.
